title: 第3章 捡到的媳妇来历惊人第4章 狗男人偷情回来了
slug: 提蓝桥刚毕业女帝求我当宰相
content_zh:
;;
“尼玛，这对狗男女还真的是恶毒呀！”
看着曹阿瞒似笑非笑的嘴脸，沈浪心底暗骂。
但表面却是故作镇定：“大人，我实在是想要帮您这个忙！”
“但您有没有考虑过，我就是一个小小的衙役，陛下会不会怀疑，我有胆子去烧府衙吗？”
“万一陛下让司天监的术士过来彻查，您有把握扛得住他们的问心能力吗？”
面对沈浪反问。
曹阿瞒的眉头也蹙成一团。
他倏然觉得，沈浪的考虑也不是没有道理。
先不说一个小小的衙役，哪来的胆子敢烧应天府衙的。
单说司天监那群术士的恐怖能力，就算是他也扛不住。
意识到沈浪应该还有话没有说完的曹阿瞒，缓缓眯起眼：“那依你的意思，谁去烧，最合适？”
眼见曹阿瞒终于把问题引到了这里。
沈浪也是缓缓抬起头，看向柳青青。
“大人，我觉得让柳青青去烧，最合适！”
“你……你放屁！”
“大人，沈浪这个狗东西，他就是在胡说八道！”
“我建议直接割掉他的舌头，让他背锅就成！”
然而。
柳青青的建议道出，曹阿瞒并没有搭理。

只是冷着脸追问：“为什么柳青青去烧，最合适？”
“因为柳青青不仅是您的小妾，更是一位炼气士！”
“在咱们大乾，炼气士突破时，都会遭遇心魔，渡不过便会失控！”
“而柳青青恰好就是火属性的炼气士，由她去烧应天府衙，不仅火焰难浇灭，更不会有人去怀疑她是故意的，还是意外！”
随着沈浪这话道出。
曹阿瞒的眼睛，彻底亮了。
他觉得沈浪说的对呀！
柳青青作为他的小妾，首先在身份与地点上，便符合了烧府衙的前提。
其次，她还是火属性的炼气士。
半夜突破，走火入魔，也属于人之常情。
这件事就算是传到陛下的耳中，恐怕陛下也不会觉得有什么问题。
更不会派遣司天监的术士，过来调查！

"Nima, these couple of bitches are really vicious!"
Looking at Cao Ah's face that seemed to be smiling but not smiling, Shen Lang cursed in his heart.
But on the surface, he pretended to be calm: "Sir, I really want to help you with this!"
"But have you ever considered that I am just a small government servant? Will Your Majesty doubt that I have the courage to burn down the government office?"
"If His Majesty sends the warlocks from Si Tianjian over for a thorough investigation, are you sure you can withstand their questioning abilities?"
Facing Shen Lang, he asked.
Cao Amo's brows also frowned.
He suddenly felt that Shen Lang's consideration was not unreasonable.
Not to mention a small government official, how could he have the courage to burn Yingtianfu government office.
Just talking about the terrifying abilities of Si Tianjian's group of warlocks, even he couldn't withstand them.
Realizing that Shen Lang probably still had something to say, Cao Ah Man slowly narrowed his eyes: "Then according to your opinion, who is the most suitable person to burn?"
Seeing that Cao Aman finally brought the problem here.
Shen Lang also slowly raised his head and looked at Liu Qingqing.
"Sir, I think it is most appropriate to let Liu Qingqing do the burning!"
"You...you fart!"
"Sir, this bitch Shen Lang is just talking nonsense!"
"I suggest just cutting out his tongue and letting him take the blame!"
However.
Liu Qingqing's suggestion came out, but Cao Aman ignored it.
He just asked with a cold face: "Why is it most suitable for Liu Qingqing to burn it?"
"Because Liu Qingqing is not only your concubine, but also a Qi practitioner!"
"When we are doing great work, when the Qi Refiners break through, they will encounter inner demons. If they cannot overcome it, they will lose control!"
"And Liu Qingqing happens to be a fire-attributed Qi practitioner. If she were to burn Yingtian Mansion Office, not only would the flames be difficult to extinguish, but no one would doubt whether she did it on purpose or by accident!"
Following Shen Lang's words.
Cao Amo's eyes were completely lit up.
He thinks Shen Lang is right!
As his concubine, Liu Qingqing met the prerequisites of burning the government office in terms of identity and location.
Secondly, she is also a fire-attributed Qi practitioner.
Breaking through in the middle of the night and becoming obsessed is also human nature.
Even if this matter reaches His Majesty's ears, I'm afraid His Majesty will not think there is any problem.
Not to mention sending the warlocks from Si Tianjian to investigate!
